items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Estela was a singer and Graciela was a singer

ctx.x: And what were they, singing or learning an instrument? Or what?

Not particularly, but my house was so musical that Estela was a singer and Graciela was a singer; my sister Anisa too could sing, so when we moved to Pobolote - before we moved to Pobolote - we moved to Liyano, is another neighborhood, and we - my my son godmother "La Ninita", they had a sexteto that's where I met Cachao, he was a little kid about ......
